data.one_liner: Provides CRC calculators as Dart converters and stream transformers.
data.what_it_does: Implements many cyclic redundancy check algorithms, exposing them as Converter objects that can process byte lists or streams. Also includes a flipper utility to modify data to achieve a target CRC value.
use_when: You need CRC checksums (e.g., CRC‑32, CRC‑64) for file integrity or protocol validation
You want a Dart‑native, null‑safe implementation without native code
You need to process data incrementally via streams
avoid_when: You require cryptographic hash functions (SHA, MD5) rather than error‑detecting CRCs
You need a checksum algorithm not covered by the library
strengths: Pure Dart, works on all Flutter platforms
Supports both one‑shot conversion and stream transformation
Provides a flexible ParametricCrc for custom CRC definitions
Includes a CrcFlipper for reverse‑engineering data to match a CRC
weaknesses: Only CRC algorithms; no other hash types
API is low‑level; no high‑level helper for common file‑checksum workflows
